objective.primaryRule: two frozen procedures on identical populations (PROTOCOL.md §10): the ORIGINAL NL0 rule = the actual-profit role of the Q1-Q6 qualified members (highest centre net; ties: selection robust, lower centre DD, label), and the experimental RA1 (four screens on cutoff evidence - open-lot multiple <= 1.5, open-lot share <= 25%, worst per-lot MAE >= -$17,500, selection worst-10% mean DD <= $35,000 - then fewest failed screens, then lowest occupancy within 5% of the best conservative training net, then ties). Each is applied to the populations L (legacy cell), B (64 base cells) and F (all 196 cells); the headline selection is F/original; fold primaries are each procedure's selection at C19, C21, C23.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres; refinement moves apart): broad 196 cells x 2 replicates x (512 screen + 2-6 islands x 256) = 401,408 base / 802,816 maximum per cutoff, x 4 cutoffs = 1,605,632 / 3,211,264; refinement <= 34 lanes per cutoff with NL0's informed schedule, about 66,000 / 118,000 per cutoff (about 264,000 / 473,000 in all). Backend evaluations: job caps from NL0's per-lane contract (23,056 per broad lane, 61,667 per refinement lane), 700 per qualified member, 60,000 per fold evaluation; worst case about 48 M, expected about 20-28 M. Counted separately: screen, rung-1/2/3 and refinement centres and neighbours, qualification, folds, retries (runs.jsonl) and archive hits.

chronologicalConsequence: Standard 2.2.0 default: a population x selector procedure whose sequential verdict fails or cannot be computed gives 'no chronological support: not a deployment-qualified candidate without the user's explicit decision'. Every verdict is labelled 'conditionally independent (fixed later-selected Growth.VGT)' (AD4). There is no informed lane (AD8). 'No qualifying successor' is a valid outcome. Governance only: never a fitness term, ranking input or gate.
